subject: Request: temporary p95 measurement carveout for holiday batch spikes
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@finpay.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@finpay.com
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary SLO exception for Nov 24-28 holiday batch window

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the quick intro call last week. We run a year-end reconciliation job that will hit your Hosted API with a short, predictable burst from Nov 24–28 (UTC). Our projections (attached) show peak qps that will push our p95 above the contracted measurement window for roughly 36–48 hours in total.

Two asks:
- Is Redwood able to provide a short-term carveout to avoid a formal SLO breach for the holiday window?
- If yes, what evidence / addendum language do you need so our procurement team can sign off?

I can loop in our compliance lead if you need additional details.

Appreciate it —
Alicia Gomez
Head of Ops, FinPay
Alicia@finpay.com

Attachment: holiday_traffic_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet; 1 sheet)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@finpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Nov 2027 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLO exception for Nov 24-28 holiday batch window

Alicia —

Thanks for the details and the forecast. Short answer: we can support a planned carveout for a narrowly-defined holiday burst, provided we agree on scope, measurement window adjustments, and an evidence package. To move quickly, here is what I propose:

1) Scope: carveout applies to FinPay production API keys only, Nov 24 00:00 UTC through Nov 28 23:59 UTC.
2) Measurement: exclude the window from p95 calculations for the hosted-account-level SLO, but retain p50 commitments.
3) Evidence: you provide traffic forecasts + request IDs; we will attach sampled latency logs for the window and include a one-time addendum to the contract.

Karthik, can the hosting runtime accept a transient measurement carveout and produce the evidence package as CSVs? Marissa, if legal can provision a short addendum template I can circulate to Alicia and procurement, we’ll aim to get sign-off before the 20th.

If that sounds reasonable, I’ll draft the addendum and the operational checklist.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
(555) 555-0146

Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@finpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLO exception for Nov 24-28 holiday batch window

Hi all —

Technically feasible. Quick notes from infra/runtime:
- We can flag the account and mark the 2027-11-24T00:00:00Z -> 2027-11-28T23:59:59Z interval as a transient carveout in our measurement pipeline. That will remove those samples from p95 aggregation for contract compliance reporting.
- We will continue to record raw samples and KV cache behavior for post-mortem.
- Deliverables we can produce by Nov 29: sampled latency CSV (token-level buckets), request ID list, and an operational summary including any fallback activations.

Operational asks for FinPay:
- Please send a list of prod API keys you want excluded (exact key ids).
- Confirm timezone for your business window (UTC assumed).

Laura — can your renewals team confirm whether billing/prorating is needed, or should we treat this as a non-billable accommodation?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Product Manager, Serving Runtime

Attachment: latency-samples-nov13-14.csv (sample)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@finpay.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 14:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLO exception for Nov 24-28 holiday batch window

Alicia / team —

Draft addendum attached. Key points:
- Clause A: carveout window definition (inclusive UTC timestamps)
- Clause B: measurement adjustment — exclude samples sourced by listed API keys for p95 reporting only; p50 remains unchanged
- Clause C: evidence delivery — Redwood to provide sampled logs and a signed operational summary within 5 business days after window close
- Clause D: limited to one annual planned carveout per account unless otherwise mutually agreed

We are not proposing any changes to liability or data residency. If FinPay needs accelerated turnaround, please confirm and we can route to legal priority.

Please review the attached draft-slo-addendum-v1.docx and let us know edits. If accepted, I can prepare a countersign flow via DocuSign.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Commercial Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-slo-addendum-v1.docx (Word document)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, ops@finpay.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 16:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Temporary SLO exception for Nov 24-28 holiday batch window

Marissa / Vivek —

This looks good and matches what our procurement will accept. Two quick clarifications before we sign:
- FinPay requests the carveout be explicitly limited to "planned reconciliation jobs" called out by request IDs we will provide. That prevents accidental exclusion of production interactive traffic.
- We accept the one-time annual carveout limitation but would like the option to request a second carveout with 30 days' notice, subject to Redwood approval.

If you can fold those two bullets into the addendum, we’ll get procurement to countersign by Nov 20. We will attach the API key list and a short sample of request IDs by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Alicia
Head of Ops, FinPay
